full_judgment: 17. Fourthly he submitted that non-examination of Delwar Bepari and Abdul Karim and sons, daughters, wife and the full brothers of the deceased cast a serious doubt on the prosecution case and for non-examination of those persons an adverse presumption shall be drawn against the prosecution under section 114(g) of the Evidence Act. But those persons as in this case were not eye witnesses to the occurrence and were not material witnesses, no presumption is available under section 114(g) of the Evidence Act against the prosecution for non-examination of those persons. I also hold the same view for non-examination of sons, daughters, wife and full brothers of the deceased as they were also not witnesses to see the occurrence.
